items.title: Rapid7 MDR Team Discovers New SonicWall SMA1000 Zero Days being Actively Exploited (CVE-2026-15409, CVE-2026-15410)
items.summary: On July 14, 2026, SonicWall published a security advisory addressing two vulnerabilities affecting SMA1000 Series remote access appliances, including the critical server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability CVE-2026-15409 (CVSS 10.0) and the high-severity code injection vulnerability CVE-2026-15410. The advisory urges customers to immediately apply the latest platform hotfix releases.

items.title: Investigating Persistence Mechanisms in AWS
items.summary: In the cloud, your infrastructure may be short-lived, but an attacker’s persistence may not be. While your environment scales and changes in seconds, adversaries are embedding themselves into your IAM policies, Lambda functions, and federated sessions – creating invisible footholds that survive long after you believe an incident is closed.

items.title: Patch Tuesday - July 2026
items.summary: Microsoft is publishing 622 vulnerabilities on July 2026 Patch Tuesday, including a record-breaking 416 Windows vulnerabilities.

items.title: CVE-2026-55040: Microsoft SharePoint JWT Token Authentication Bypass (FIXED)
items.summary: Rapid7 Labs conducted a zero-day research project against Microsoft SharePoint, resulting in the discovery of 2 new vulnerabilities that – when chained together – achieve unauthenticated remote code execution against a vulnerable SharePoint server. More in a new technical blog post.

items.title: Rapid7 and Mindware Partner to Accelerate Cyber Resilience Across the Middle East
items.summary: Rapid7 and Mindware announce a strategic distribution partnership to help Middle East partners deliver stronger cyber resilience, security operations, and customer outcomes.

items.title: Weekly Metasploit Update: Exploits for FlowiseAI CSV Agent and MacOS Package Kit
items.summary: Stay up to date with the latest Metasploit Framework releases. This week's update introduces new exploit modules for the Flowise CSV Agent, Apache .htaccess persistence, and a macOS PackageKit privilege escalation, alongside several improvements to FTP target fingerprinting, AD CS certificate tracing, and critical bug fixes.

items.title: Security Teams Are Ready To Become More Preemptive. What’s Holding Them Back?
items.summary: The shift toward preemptive security is underway, but most organizations are still navigating the realities of limited resources, fragmented tools, and emerging AI risk. At Rapid7’s recent Global Security Summit, we surveyed attendees to better understand where security leaders and practitioners stand today, what is shaping their priorities, and what they need to move forward.

items.title: A Day With Your Vector Command Red Team Pod
items.summary: Anyone trying to understand 'continuous red teaming' usually gets the same high-level explanation: it is ongoing, attacker-informed, and designed to uncover risk between formal assessments. Useful as that description is, it still leaves most people with the same question, which is what the service actually looks like when a team is working against a real environment day after day. Dive in with a new blog.

items.title: Weekly Metasploit Update: Modules for SMB-to-Meterpreter, Peyara Remote Mouse RCE exploit, and more
items.summary: This week's Metasploit Framework release adds an SMB-to-Meterpreter upgrade module, a LoongArch64 exec payload, and a Peyara Remote Mouse RCE exploit, alongside one enhancement and two bug fixes.

items.title: Formalizing Red Teaming Offensive Methodology as a Multi-Agent AI Architecture
items.summary: Threat actors are integrating AI into their exploit chains. Rapid7's Red Team is doing the same. This blog post covers the underlying architecture, key design decisions, and what we learned along the way.

items.title: 5 Myths About AI in the SOC Security Teams Need to Rethink
items.summary: AI is now part of almost every conversation in security operations. Most teams are already investing in it, experimenting with it, or trying to understand where it fits. At the Rapid7 Global Cybersecurity Summit, "The AI Dilemma: Automating Defense Without Surrendering Judgment" explores how AI is being used in the SOC today, and where it creates real value in practice.

items.title: Modernizing Global Vulnerability Standards For The Age Of AI
items.summary: As AI-driven vulnerability discovery accelerates, the cybersecurity ecosystem is being forced to examine whether the standards, disclosure processes, and prioritization frameworks defenders rely on can still keep pace. In Rapid7’s new policy paper, understand where today’s vulnerability management infrastructure is breaking under AI-era conditions, and what governments, security companies, and frontier AI providers need to do next.

items.title: Weekly Metasploit Update: Modules for Audiobookshelf, LiteLLM, Next.js, Dalfox and more
items.summary: Metasploit is currently seeking user feedback on planned improvements to evasion capabilities via a proposal and feedback form that remains open until July 1, 2026. The latest update includes several new security modules, such as detection scanners for Audiobookshelf, LiteLLM Proxy, and Next.js, along with a new exploit module for Dalfox. Additionally, the release incorporates improvements to authentication brute-force modules and networking sockets, with further details and documentation available on the official Metasploit docsite.

items.title: Experts on Experts: Why AI and Compliance Are Forcing A New Security Operating Model
items.summary: In a new episode of Experts on Experts, Rapid7 Executive Chairman Corey Thomas sits down with Sabeen Malik, VP of Global Government Affairs and Public Policy, to discuss a shift security leaders can’t afford to treat as separate threads: frontier AI, vulnerability discovery, cybersecurity compliance, and operational resilience.

items.summary: Rapid7 has been named a Major Player in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide SIEM 2026 Vendor Assessment, the first IDC SIEM MarketScape to bring the enterprise and SMB markets into a single evaluation.
